checks.item: Independence House: completed 1961, height 103 m, at 6.4469, 3.3989 (documented)
checks.found: Wikipedia article: completion 1961, roof 103 m, 25 floors, coordinates 6°26'48.9"N 3°23'56"E (6.4469, 3.3989). Wikipedia list (citing SkyscraperPage 38507): 103 m, 23 floors, 1960. Nkanga, cited by the article: construction 'began in 1959 but was completed in 1961', '25 storeys high', '300-feet from the ground'. SkyscraperPage itself returned 403 and the Wayback copy could not be reached.
checks.detail: Year and coordinates hold, but the 103 m height rests on a database page I could not open and the other source says 300 ft (about 91 m). Lowered confidence from documented to estimated and added a note giving both figures; height_m left at 103.

checks.item: Eko Champagne Pearl Tower (Eko Atlantic): completed 2017, height 103 m, at 6.4098, 3.412 (estimated)
checks.found: CTBUH: completion 2017, height 103 m / 338 ft, 'this height is estimated, based on a floor count of 30 floors'. Wikipedia: coordinates 6.4098, 3.4120; Champagne Pearl 134 m, 30 floors.

checks.item: 1898: Electric lighting switched on (19 September 1898, 60 kW, Marina from Government House to the north side of the island)
checks.found: 'Electrification was implemented in Lagos on 19 September 1898 ... The total generation at that time was 60 kilowatts (kW). The power line supplied the Lagos marina from the Government House to the north side of the island' (citing Olukoju).
checks.detail: Date and details match the cited page.

checks.item: 1924: Bubonic plague and clearance of the island (1924-1931, 1,947 cases; swamps drained, residents resettled on the mainland)
checks.found: Wikipedia (Faleye 2019): 'The epidemic, which began in 1924 and lasted until 1931, was the cause of a total of 1,947 cases and 1,813 deaths'. Olukoju ch. 1: 'In response to the bubonic plagues of 1924-30, entire neighbourhoods were evacuated', 'swamps (such as at Oko Awo) were drained and people re-settled on the mainland'.
checks.detail: Year, case count and the clearance and resettlement are all supported; Olukoju gives the end year as 1930, Faleye as 1931.

summary: Nine of 10 items matched their sources. The 103 m height of Independence House could not be traced to a source I could open and another source gives about 91 m, so its confidence was lowered to estimated with a note.
